_说明: 前作神居（分支 hk1-godhome）：手办屋的前作雕像放本作的 Boss。bosses.json 的雕像表是 43 尊（同一个 Boss 的几个形态在一尊上，拉杆依次切换，照前作的变体雕像）。前作手办屋有 36 尊在用，再用上一直空着的骑士雕像（GG_Statue_Knight），在空地上照前作的雕像复制 6 尊（Hk1Hall.Extra），正好 43 尊。0.10.6 以前为了凑 36 尊把 7 对不相干的 Boss 并在一尊上（拉杆会把黑寡妇切成炽焰之父），用户实测反馈后拆开。前作的皮鬼雕像（藏在墙后）放巨蚤，辐光雕像（最高处）放崇高圣母灵丝；其余按幕和表里的顺序，先下层从左到右，再上层从左到右。
_note: HK1 Godhome (branch hk1-godhome): Silksong bosses on the Hall of Gods statues. bosses.json has 43 statues (forms of the same boss share one; the lever cycles through them, like HK1's alternate statues). The hall's 36 statues in use, the unused Knight statue and 6 copies of HK1 statues on empty floor (Hk1Hall.Extra) make 43. Before 0.10.6, 7 pairs of unrelated bosses shared a statue to fit 36; split after player feedback. The hidden Zote statue holds the Huge Flea and the Radiance statue holds Grand Mother Silk; the rest follow act and table order, lower row left to right, then the upper row.
